name: Munakata
source:
The main character of this story. He is a strong warrior who is even called a national hero.
With his blessed physique and inexhaustible courage, he ran through many battlefields and achieved great results.

He has a very serious and honest personality. He is the inflexible Park Yeon-in.
Although his subordinates and colleagues liked him because of his personality, his superiors often disliked him.

This time, his assignment to protect the Princess was also at the request of the higher-ups who were jealous of his popularity and disliked him.
